title: Quick Tip: Public preview for Business Central 2025 release wave 2 is available.
summary: Business Central version 27 is available in public preview for testing. Contributors can report bugs via a forms submission or provide feedback in the Yammer group, helping Microsoft identify and fix issues before the official release.
key_points: Version 27 of Business Central is now available as a preview sandbox for testing
Bugs should be reported through a forms submission at aka.ms/bcpreviewbugs
Feedback and questions can be shared in the Public Preview 2025 release wave 2 Yammer group
Several feature keys are now mandatory, removed, enabled by default, or disabled by default
Notable features include package tracking in physical inventory, related table fields in analysis mode, and semantic similarity search
features: Package tracking in physical inventory orders
Add fields from related tables in analysis mode
Server certificate validation for HTTP requests
Semantic similarity search on application metadata

quotes.text: You can now create a preview sandbox of version 27 of Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Signals the availability of the preview environment for early testing and feedback.
Provides the specific mechanism for reporting issues discovered during testing.
